items.type:

  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ and $N$ be additive commutative monoids, where $N$ is equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any subadditive function $f : M \to N$ satisfying $f(0) \leq 0$, and for any finite set $s$ of indices and function $g : s \to M$, it holds that $f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i))$.

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality on Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) →
      (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) →
        ∀ (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) → f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description:
Let $ M $ and $ N $ be additive commutative monoids with $ N $ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any function $ f : M → N $ satisfying $ f(0) ≤ 0 $, and predicate $ p : M → 	ext{Prop} $ such that:
1. $ f $ is subadditive on $ p $-elements: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ f(x + y) ≤ f(x) + f(y) $,
2. $ p $-elements are closed under addition: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ p(x + y) $,
then for any finite set $ s $ and function $ g : ι → M $ with $ p(g(i)) $ for all $ i ∈ s $, we have:
$$
 f\left(\sum_{i ∈ s} g(i)\right) ≤ \sum_{i ∈ s} f(g(i)).
$$

  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (a b : α), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) → ∀ (l : List α), f l.sum ≤ (List.map f l).sum
items.informal_description: Let $ \alpha $ be an additive monoid and $ \beta $ an ordered commutative additive monoid. For any function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ satisfying $ f(0) \leq 0 $ and subadditivity $ f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b) $ for all $ a, b \in \alpha $, it holds that $ f(\sum_{x \in l} x) \leq \sum_{x \in l} f(x) $ for any finite list $ l $ of elements in $ \alpha $.

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality for List Sums
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} {β : Type u_6} [inst : AddMonoid α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    p 0 →
      (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) →
        (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → p (a + b)) → ∀ (l : List α), (∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → p a) → f l.sum ≤ (List.map f l).sum
items.informal_description: Let $ \alpha $ be an additive monoid and $ \beta $ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For a function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and predicate $ p : \alpha \to \mathrm{Prop} $, if $ f(0) \leq 0 $, $ p(0) $ holds, $ f $ is subadditive on $ p $-elements (i.e., $ f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b) $ whenever $ p(a) $ and $ p(b) $), and $ p $ is closed under addition, then for any list $ l $ of $ \alpha $-elements satisfying $ p $, it holds that $ f(\sum l) \leq \sum_{x \in l} f(x) $.

items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (a b : α), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) → ∀ (s : Multiset α), f s.sum ≤ (Multiset.map f s).sum
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be additive commutative monoids, with $\beta$ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ satisfying $f(0) \leq 0$ and subadditivity $f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b)$ for all $a, b \in \alpha$, it holds that $f(\sum s) \leq \sum_{x \in s} f(x)$ for every multiset $s$ over $\alpha$. Here, $\sum s$ denotes the sum of elements in the multiset $s$.

For any subadditive function $ f : M \to N $ (i.e., $ f(x + y) \leq f(x) + f(y) $ for all $ x, y \in M $), any non-empty finite set $ s $, and any function $ g : s \to M $, it holds that $ f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i)) $.

    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) →

items.informal_description: Let $ M $ and $ N $ be additive commutative monoids, with $ N $ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. Suppose $ f : M \to N $ is subadditive on a predicate $ p : M \to \mathrm{Prop} $ (i.e., $ f(x + y) \leq f(x) + f(y) $ whenever $ p(x) $ and $ p(y) $), and $ p $ is closed under addition (i.e., $ p(x) $ and $ p(y) $ imply $ p(x + y) $). Then, for any non-empty finite set $ s $ and function $ g : s \to M $ with $ p(g(i)) $ for all $ i \in s $, it holds that $ f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i)) $.

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality for Predicate-Closed Lists in Additive Monoids
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_5} {β : Type u_6} [inst : AddMonoid α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop),
  (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) →
    (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → p (a + b)) →
      ∀ (l : List α), l ≠ [] → (∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → p a) → f l.sum ≤ (List.map f l).sum
items.informal_description: Given an additive monoid $\alpha$, an ordered commutative additive monoid $\beta$, and a predicate $p : \alpha \to \mathrm{Prop}$ closed under addition, if a function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ is subadditive on elements satisfying $p$ (i.e., $f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b)$ whenever $p(a)$ and $p(b)$), then for any non-empty list $l$ of elements in $\alpha$ where all elements satisfy $p$, the inequality $f(\sum l) \leq \sum_{x \in l} f(x)$ holds.
